_about: Frozen pipeline rules for the AAI-590 dashcam PCI capstone. Frozen 2026-11-14 (Day 4B), after the V3 mask review and survivorship audit and BEFORE any embedding-based model result. Every later script reads this file; change it only with a dated note in 'changes' and report both versions.
changes: 2026-11-14 (same session, before any real V6/V7 run; no rule changed): added 'stale_set' (the V7/H3 data the sampler did not produce before) and a printed V7 GUARD line. The v6_v7.py selftest showed that a model with no signal passes V7 whenever the stale segments' 2023 labels average below the training mean (real data: stale ~49 vs primary ~68), so V7 is reported together with the mean predictor's value and is not read as evidence of signal on its own.

2026-11-15 (Day 5; records events of Day 4C and Day 5; NO rule changed). (1) Day 4C sampler deviations, per run, measured before use: 11-14-2026-Encanto planned with 'sample_frames.py plan --min-lag -1 --clock-shift 2' (every clip's first GPS fix 1 s before its filename time; V2 seed 596 FAIL 4/10 with burned-in positions consistently ~1.9 s behind the control drives; after the shift V2 seed 616 FAIL 9/10, one 29-mph frame 0.0003 deg off, kept). 11-13-2026-SE-SD V2 seed 594 FAIL 9/10 (burned-in clock +2 s late in a clip, position exact), kept. V6 and V7 ran once with this file at SHA-256 be58155b (V6 PASS: MAE 13.22 vs 25.93, Spearman 0.75; V7 PASS 85.3 vs 55.7, mean predictor 63.0). (2) 11-15-2026-Uptown, the last drive (camera set to standard time: clock error 0): V2 seed 597 FAIL 9/10 (clock +2 s late in a clip; all 10 positions within 0.0001); burned-in positions put Uptown ~1 s from the control drives and an automatic -2 s clock-sync correction on clip 003451F looked like a missing-fix artifact (~1 s the other way); both within the stated +-1 s alignment, kept. V3-local seed 607 FAIL 13/20: SegFormer-B0 leaves light concrete roadway untinted (7 frames, all concrete); Uptown tiles kept 0.59 vs 0.84-0.93 on the other drives, and on Uptown rejection tracked condition. Per the V3-local rule (Day 4C) Uptown is EXCLUDED from every analysis set. Analysis dataset = the Day 4C tables (data/modeling_4C: 5 drives, 173 primary, 181 secondary, 52 stale), identical to the rebuilt tables minus Uptown. (3) The model ladder (rungs 1-5, leave-street-out and leave-area-out, Gate 2 rule, H3 design, MIL grid, ablations) was pre-registered in the header and constants of 05_training/ladder.py (SHA-256 f3e15a48) before any ladder result.

frame_sampling.segment_assignment: both bracketing 1 Hz fixes passed every Gate 0 rule and snapped to the same clean segment
frame_sampling.clock: per-clip whole-hour error {0, -3600 s} + start lag 0-3 s; clock-sync correction when a clip's lag differs from the drive's usual lag by > 1 s
frame_sampling.extraction: one ffmpeg call per frame, software decoding, JPEG q2, native 3840x2160

mask.upsampling: bilinear on logits at the working size, then argmax (M6)

embedding.frame_vector: mean of the frame's kept tiles

handcrafted_rung3.frame_value: mean of the frame's kept tiles

pooling_and_models.ridge_V6_and_rung4: per segment: mean and std of the frame vectors, concatenated
pooling_and_models.attention_mil_rung5: bag = segment, instance = frame vector (tile-level instances = ablation)

analysis_sets.alleys: excluded from every set (name contains the word ALLEY, frozen 2026-11-13)

gates.V6_V7_count_only_if: >= 150 PRIMARY usable segments across >= 2 planning areas with >= 20 each
gates.V6: ridge on pooled (mean+std) primary vectors vs mean predictor, CV grouped by street: MAE >= 10% below the mean predictor AND Spearman >= 0.3
gates.V7: mean prediction on stale segments > their mean 2023 label
gates.preliminary_V6: not run before the gate is met (decided 2026-11-14)
gates.V7_guard: context only: also print the mean predictor's value for the stale set; if it also exceeds the stale labels, V7 alone is not evidence of signal

evidence_2026_11_14.intersection_paint: 6/50 review frames had paint in a kept tile; distance to the segment end ahead 24, 24, 28, 29, 35, 36 m; none in 39 frames >= 40 m
evidence_2026_11_14.survivorship: Spearman(PCI, share of tiles kept) = -0.01; tiles kept 0.87-0.92 in every band; non-road pixels are sidewalk/car in every band
evidence_2026_11_14.worst_pci_page: cracks, patches and a manhole in Very Poor/Serious frames are tinted as road inside kept tiles
evidence_2026_11_14.V4: mask 0.49 + embed 0.11 = 0.59 s/frame -> 1,440 frames 14 min, ~3,000 frames 30 min -> PASS (< 60 min); extraction ~0.28 s/frame reported separately
evidence_2026_11_14.mask_batching: batch 1: 0.47 s/frame, batch 4: 5.5 s/frame on mps (first 572 frames were masked at batch 4; same model and preprocessing)

stale_set.definition: driven segments that are labeled and stale (is_stale in segments_clean.csv: latest repair ended on/after 2023-02-01)
stale_set.frames: same sampler rules as the clean set; separate table frames_<SESSION>__stale.csv and folder data/frames/<SESSION>__stale/
stale_set.rules: same mask, strip, tile rule, end trim and >= 3 frames as the primary set
stale_set.use: V7 and the H3 check only; never trained on
stale_set.context_subset: repaired_after_survey_end = last repair ended after 2023-08-31 (survey ran Feb-Aug 2023)
